# Goban Studio v17.0.0

v17 adds nothing new. It makes what is there steadier and more complete:
the packaged app now checks its own pages on both platforms before a
release, the openings explorer has its joseki branches back, the whole
course was checked again with the stronger KataGo network, and a few
rough edges are smoothed. v17 reads everything v9–v16 saved; nothing has
to be converted.

## Download and first launch

<!-- first-launch -->
| Platform | File | First launch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `GobanStudio-macOS-arm64.dmg` or `.zip` | See the package README. |
| macOS (Intel) | `GobanStudio-macOS-x64.dmg` or `.zip` | See the package README. |
| Windows (x64) | `GobanStudio-Windows-x64.zip` | See the package README. |
<!-- /first-launch -->

`SHA256SUMS` lists the checksums of every file. v17 needs macOS 13 or
later. Your games, progress and settings are kept outside the app — in
`~/Library/Application Support/dev.hxddh.gobanstudio` on macOS and
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\dev.hxddh.gobanstudio\Data` on Windows — so replacing the
app keeps them.

## Openings and lessons

- **The openings explorer has its branches back.** The book made with the
  stronger network in v16 had lost a quarter of its corner positions;
  it now has about 1,700 again, and the 3-4 point's high approach shows
  two answers.
- **The whole course was checked with the stronger network**, every
  unit, for the first time since the newest units were written. One
  lesson changed with it: "Urgent points before big points". Its board
  made the empty corner worth more than the group it asked you to save;
  now White holds that corner, and the big point is the approach to it.
- The knight's move joseki lesson is now judged by the book too (its
  two-space extension is within half a point of KataGo's best).

## Classics and Practice

- **The notes on the classics' key moments** read less alike: the same
  measured facts, in three wordings that take turns within a game.
- **A classic's picture in the Library** is the corner of one of its key
  moments, readable at that size, instead of the crowded final position.
- **Each unit of the course has a picture with stones enough to read**;
  two units that had none have one.

## Settings

- The Engines pane's wording is shorter, so it fits with larger text in
  all four languages with room to spare.

## Under the hood

- **The packaged app checks its own pages.** Before a release (and on
  every pull request that touches the app), the packaged app on macOS and
  Windows walks a player's first minutes by itself: it changes the
  language, opens a lesson, a problem, a classic and the openings
  explorer, plays a game and opens its review, and reads each page back.
  v16.0.0's macOS fault (fixed in v16.0.1) would have failed here.
- Every place where the platform decides something (the app's own files,
  saving, the engine, menus, dialogs, opening a file, sound, the theme) is
  listed with the check that covers it (`docs/QA.md`).
- Playwright 1.65.1 and ESLint 10.15 for the tests.

## Known limits

- **Platform code has not been tried by hand.** The Metal and AVX2
  engines and their fallback, the speed they reach, a save surviving a
  power cut, and the macOS title bar following the app's appearance pass
  their tests and the packaged self-test on CI, but nobody has run them on
  a real Mac or PC. Settings → Engines → Measure speed is there to check
  the first two; please report what it shows.
- **Not checked by people.** The changed lessons, the KataGo notes on the
  classics, the move verdicts and the strings in Chinese, Korean and
  Japanese have not been reviewed by a strong player or native speakers.
- **Lessons KataGo disagrees with.** A few lessons on small 9×9 boards
  teach the local shape while KataGo prefers a big point elsewhere, and
  the 3-3 joseki teaches the standard connection where KataGo prefers a
  cut (`docs/lesson-audit.md`); they are left as taught.
- **The builds are not code-signed.** macOS and Windows warn on first
  launch; the README in each download says what to do.
- **There is no Windows installer.** The download is a zip.
- **No Traditional Chinese interface.** The problem bank tops out at
  about 5 kyu.
